name: Korea trip plan
description: Plan a Korea trip: schedule, research notes and who's coming.

meta.note: Consolidates trip SCHEDULE (dated plan items) and RESEARCH (notes/links/candidate places gathered while planning) into one applet, built 2026-08-13. Data shape and no-login identity pattern are deliberately copied from `tripboard` (ONE `entries` table, kind discriminator, `relations` contains-edges — the only table names the share pipeline syncs) rather than reinvented; see MIGRATION.md. Identity is a per-install `krtravelplanMemberId` setting picked via a member card (never sign-in, never $playerId) -- every content row's `author` is stamped `$setting:krtravelplanMemberId`. UPDATE 2026-08-14: the engine originally had no string-transform primitive, so the 'Badge' field shipped as a SECOND self-chosen text field typed alongside the name -- that gap is now closed. `flutterboard/lib/src/data/text_transforms.dart` adds a named `initials` transform (Latin: first letter per word, capped at 3; single CJK token e.g. Korean: last 2 characters, the given-name part for the common 1-syllable-surname shape; empty input -> ''), and `record_editor.dart` gained a generic cross-field `rules: {deriveFrom, deriveFn}` column rule (fill-only-while-empty, same shape as the existing completion-stamp reconcile) that any applet's column can opt into. `columns.json`'s `initials` column now declares `rules: {"deriveFrom": "title", "deriveFn": "initials"}`, so the Badge auto-fills from the typed name on save and stays overridable (type your own -> it sticks; clear it -> re-derives). Bilingual en/ko throughout via inline {en,ko} maps, matching krtravel's convention. A Research card can jump to krtravel's map via hostCall openApplet for a place lookup (updated 2026-08-16, appletgc-0816, when krtravel2 was retired and krtravel restored to apps/apps.json); krtravel is NOT modified by this applet.
